fld001.desc: unique id number identifying the cards

fld003.desc: The ASCII(opens new window) (Basic/128) code formatted card name with no special unicode characters.

commonsense evidence:
cardKingdomFoilId, when paired with cardKingdomId that is not Null, is incredibly powerful.

fld008.desc: A list of all the colors found in manaCost, colorIndicator, and text

fld012.desc: The indicator for which duel deck the card is in.

fld015.desc: The name on the face of the card.

fld016.desc: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function.
fld016.values: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function.

fld017.desc: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function.
fld017.values: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function.

fld019.desc: The version of the card frame style.

fld020.desc: The starting maximum hand size total modifier.
fld020.values:
A + or - character precedes an integer. 
commonsense evidence:
positive maximum hand size: +1, +2, ....
negative maximum hand size: -1, ....
neural maximum hand size: 0....

fld021.desc: If the card allows a value other than 4 copies in a deck.

fld022.desc: If the card marked by Wizards of the Coast (opens new window) for having sensitive content. See this official article (opens new window) for more information.
fld022.values:
0: doesn't have 1: has sensitve content or Wizards of the Coast
commonsense evidence:
Cards with this property may have missing or degraded properties and values.

fld023.desc: If the card can be found in foil
fld023.values: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found

fld024.desc: If the card can be found in non-foil
fld024.values: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found

fld025.desc: If the card is an alternate variation to an original printing

fld026.desc: If the card has full artwork.

fld027.desc: If the card is only available in online game variations.

fld029.desc: If the card is a promotional printing.

fld030.desc: If the card has been reprinted.

fld031.values: If the card is on the Magic, it will appear in The Gathering Reserved List

fld032.desc: If the card is found in a starter deck such as Planeswalker/Brawl decks.

fld033.desc: If the card is a Story Spotlight card.

fld034.desc: If the card does not have a text box.

fld035.desc: If the card is time shifted
fld035.values:
commonsense evidence:
If the card is "timeshifted", a feature of certain sets where a card will have a different frameVersion.

fld036.desc: A list of keywords found on the card.

fld041.desc: The mana cost of the card wrapped in brackets for each value.
fld041.values:
commonsense evidence:
manaCost is unconverted mana cost

fld052.values: The text on the card as originally printed.

fld053.values: The type of the card as originally printed. Includes any supertypes and subtypes.

fld054.values: A list of card UUID's to this card's counterparts, such as transformed or melded faces.

fld055.values:
commonsense evidence:
∞ means infinite power
null or * refers to unknown power

fld056.desc: A list of set printing codes the card was printed in, formatted in uppercase.

fld064.desc: The identifier of the card side.
fld064.values:
Used on cards with multiple faces on the same card.
commonsense evidence:
if this value is empty, then it means this card doesn't have multiple faces on the same card.

fld065.desc: A list of card subtypes found after em-dash.

fld066.desc: A list of card supertypes found before em-dash.
fld066.values:

list of all types should be the union of subtypes and supertypes

fld068.desc: The rules text of the card.

fld074.desc: The name of the watermark on the card.

if the value is null or empty, then it doesn't appear on Magic: The Gathering Online
